title: lobbyist_pac
description: One committee of a cycle run by a registered lobbyist or a lobbying registrant (a lobbyist/registrant PAC), from the FEC's lobbyist/registrant committees file (from 2010): a committee whose latest statement of organization (Form 1) filed by the cycle's last day ticks the lobbyist/registrant box. A committee with no row is not one in the cycle. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

filed_date.description: The date the deciding Form 1 was filed.

image_num.description: The FEC image number of the deciding Form 1.
